name: Machine Seated Row
steps: Sit in a seated row machine with your chest braced squarely against the pad, feet flat on the footrests or floor, and hands gripping the handles.
Start with your arms extended straight in front of you and your shoulders relaxed forward into a mild stretch.
Drive your elbows back to pull the handles toward your torso while squeezing your shoulder blades firmly together.
Control the handles slowly back to full arm extension before starting the next repetition.
tips: Keep your chest firmly in contact with the support pad so you do not use body momentum.
Avoid hunching your shoulders toward your neck as you pull.
